subtitle.en: Core algebraic reasoning, problem-solving, and quantitative analysis for the EST I university-admissions test.

note.en: Register & access official EST practice materials

downloadsInfo.introText: Take the EST I Math material offline. The PDF prints straight from your browser; the Word packet contains editable OMML equations ready to customise.
downloadsInfo.pdfCardDescription: All eight chapters plus every worked solution, formatted as a clean print document.
downloadsInfo.docxCardDescription: Editable .docx with real Word equations (OMML) — all EST I topics ready for classroom printing.
downloadsInfo.worksheetLibraryText: 8 original ClipSAT worksheets with full answer keys, organized by unit — free to download and print.

testGenerator.introText: Build a randomised EST I Math mini-test from the question bank, or generate a complete full-length paper that mirrors the official EST I Mathematics exam format — Section I (no calculator) and Section II (calculator permitted).
testGenerator.examDescription: Generates a complete 44-question EST I Mathematics paper — 22 questions per section — formatted to resemble an official exam. Print it as a timed practice paper.
